title: Hold a pipeline licence
what: Construct, alter or operate a petroleum pipeline only under a pipeline licence.

sources.title: Petroleum Pipelines Act 1969 (WA)
sources.quote: A person shall not — (a) commence, or continue the construction of a pipeline; or (b) alter or reconstruct a pipeline, except under and in pursuance of a licence.
